info.title: GATEWAY-batchinsertion-Delete Auto Insurance Quotes Cancel-v4-spec
info.description: This API allows users to cancel auto insurance quotes in batch, facilitating efficient management of quotes. It serves as a crucial tool for insurance agents and financial institutions looking to streamline their quote cancellation processes. By leveraging this endpoint, users can ensure that unwanted or outdated quotes are effectively removed from their systems, thus improving operational efficiency. The API is designed for integration with various systems within the auto insurance domain, targeting agents, brokers, and financial applications.

delete.description: This operation cancels an existing quote in the system. Ensure that the quote ID is provided to successfully execute the cancellation.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to specify the details for canceling a quote. You must include the necessary parameters to indicate which quote should be canceled.

200.description: The cancel request was processed successfully.

DeleteAutoInsuranceQuotesCancelRequest.description: This schema represents the request body for cancelling a quote operation using the DELETE method.
